title: INT8 weight-only fidelity sentinel and calibration canary playbook
creator: Samir Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated canary + sentinel workflow that validates INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles end-to-end before they are promoted to the runtime registry. This ticket covers the integration points, regression harness, fidelity thresholds, chaos/latency probes, and an operational rollback path.

Scope:
- Integrate profile artifacts (calibration tables, per-layer ranges) into the profile registry and CI gates.
- Define golden prompt sets and evaluation metrics (task accuracy, perplexity deltas, top-k agreement, hallucination heuristics).
- Canary workflow that runs on a fraction of live traffic and a nightly synthetic regression suite.
- Telemetry and alerting for fidelity drift with automated rollback and model-variant fallback to FP16 baseline.

Out of scope: model training, new quant algorithms (we will consume GPTQ/AWQ outputs produced by Research), and large-scale re-benchmarking that requires new hardware procurement.
acceptance_criteria: Canary pipeline executes quantized candidate against golden prompt set and returns a pass/fail score within 30 minutes.
Automated regression job compares candidate outputs to FP16 baseline and computes agreed fidelity metrics (delta-EM, top-1 agreement, avg token-level logprob delta).
A sentinel monitor on production route can route 1% traffic to candidate variant with automatic reversion policy if latency or fidelity SLOs break.
Telemetry dashboard surfaces per-model, per-layer calibration drift and alerting thresholds are documented with runbook.
Playbook includes steps for manual triage, rollback, and patching of calibration artifacts (with links to PR templates).
steps: Design: finalize golden prompt corpus and metric definitions with Applied ML (owner: Maya).
Infra: extend profile-registry schema to include calibration fingerprint and origin metadata (owner: Infra).
CI: add integration stage that runs quantized candidate against nightly regression harness (owner: CI).
Canary: implement traffic-splitting hook with sentinel checks (owner: Routing).
Monitoring: create dashboard and alerts, implement event-based runbook automation (owner: Observability).
Ops: document manual rollback and emergency steps, add to on-call rotations (owner: SRE).

notes_for_review: Proposed fidelity thresholds are deliberately conservative: top-1 agreement >= 97%, avg token logprob delta <= 0.12, and task-specific EM delta <= 1.5% for high-value tasks.
If a candidate fails only on latency but passes fidelity, routing policy should prefer FP16 due to SLO constraints and queue calibration-run for further profiling.
We should include a golden-seed test that fixes RNG seeds for deterministic diffs on regression harness; draft in GH tests/seeded-golden-suite.js.
